name: Migao Group Holdings Limited
summary: Migao Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages manufacturing and trading of specialty potash-based fertilizers in the People's Republic of China. It provides potassium chloride, potassium sulphate, hydrochloric acid, and compound fertilizers and resells potassium nitrate. The company also offers warehousing and research and development services. It sells its products to agricultural reclamation and agribusiness companies. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. Migao Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Migao Holding Limited.
